i_design_a_basis: A, design maximum continuous load current (designer decision 2026-11-15, spec.md Operating conditions).
ta_basis: degC, ambient range 5 to 40 degC (laboratory; IEC 61010-1 normal environmental conditions, cl. 1.4.1; spec.md).
t_ref_c_basis: degC, reference temperature for the shunt TCR. The WSK2512-LOW DS states none; 25 degC is an ASSUMPTION (same as the INA229HighSideMonitor).
vbus_basis: V, rated bus 12 to 40 V DC; the bench instance runs on 12 V nominal (designer decision 2026-11-15, spec.md).
vbus_min_v_basis: V, minimum BUS_IN in normal use: 12 V -10 % (spec.md).
uvlo_margin_v_basis: V, required margin of the worst-case UVLO turn-on voltage below vbus_min_v (designer, spec.md: ample headroom for tolerance at 12 V nominal).
ov_min_v_basis: V, the OV rising trip must never be below this (12 V +10 %, spec.md).
i_div_basis: uA, divider current window at 12 V nominal (DESIGN CHOICE: at least 20 x the EN/UVLO leakage per DS p.24, at most 20 uA to keep the bus load small).
v3v3_basis: V and fraction, board logic rail V3V3, +/-3 % (spec.md, same rail as the INA229HighSideMonitor).
rshunt_basis: ohm and WSK2512-LOW tolerance code: 4 mohm, +/-0.5 % (spec.md, option study hss_study6.py; the stocked value is an open item).
riscp_basis: ohm, ISCP resistor (spec.md): the library row v_scp_r10k5 bounds V(SCP) for exactly this value.
ctmr_basis: F, fault-timer capacitor CTMR (spec.md; same value as C1, one BOM line).
rtmr_basis: ohm, latch-off resistor across CTMR (DS p.19; spec.md).
r1_basis: ohm, gate ramp resistor R1, PU to the gate (DS p.16 suggestion; spec.md).
c1_basis: F, gate ramp capacitor C1, gate to GND (DS Fig 7-4 p.15: gate -> R2 -> C1 -> GND; C1 returns to GND, not SRC, designer correction D12). Designer: common soft-start value (spec.md decision D13).
r2_basis: ohm, gate damping resistor R2 in series with C1 (DS p.16, ~10 ohm; DS Fig 7-4 p.15; spec.md).
c_small_basis: Preferred dielectric and tolerance of the 6.8 nF capacitors (C1, CTMR) when the GCM188 catalog lists it (designer 2026-11-15 and D13: C0G +/-5 %, GCM1885C2A682JE02); otherwise the analysis falls back to X7R and says so.
dv_bst_v_basis: V, allowed BST ripple in DS eq. 4 / 9 (DS p.16 text: 1 V; DESIGN CHOICE as in the DS example).
cload_f_basis: F, reference load capacitance for the inrush and SOA study (designer decision 2026-11-15).
i_fault_a_basis: A, prospective short-circuit current at BUS_IN: a system requirement on the PSU current limit or a per-channel fuse (designer decision 2026-11-15).
l_lead_uh_basis: uH, lead inductance sweep for the turn-off avalanche energy (DESIGN INPUT: the real inductance is not known).
t_elem_limit_c_basis: degC, ASSUMPTION: shunt element limit, read as the derating curve's zero point (derate_zero). NOT t_oper, which the library records as an AMBIENT rating.
divider_basis: ohm, UVLO/OV ladder BUS_IN - r_top - EN/UVLO - r_mid - OV - r_bot - GND (DS Fig 7-5 p.16). SELECTED by the analysis (section 4 rule); the analysis checks these values equal its own selection.
pullup_basis: ohm, FAULT_N and PGOOD_N pull-ups to V3V3 (designer choice, spec.md).
